# FI-CA Contract Account Field Definitions

| Field Name | Technical Key | Description | Required |
|------------|---------------|-------------|----------|
| Contract Account | VKONT | Unique identifier for customer billing account | Yes |
| Company Code | BUKRS | Organizational unit in FI | Yes |
| Account Class | VKTYP | Classification key determining posting specs | Yes |
| Payment Method | ZAHLM | Default payment method for automatic debit | No |
